## Hermes digest – gpu-watch
08:22 Europe/Athens → Talk room of profile gpu-watch.

Reads hermes/gpu-watchlist.example.yml (mounted read-only at /home/node/.n8n-files/gpu-watchlist.yml). For each product it loads the shop search page and reads the schema.org Product offers (JSON-LD): in-stock graphics cards whose name matches (a 5070 never counts as a 5070 Ti). Lowest price per product; ALERT when below target_price. Only plaisio.gr is readable from this host (skroutz.gr and bestprice.gr: bot challenge; public.gr, you.gr: 403). No LLM. No in-stock offer = no message.

Manual run = dry run: the result is returned, nothing is posted. Another workflow can call this one with {"dry_run": false|true, "use_llm": false, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. The workflow is its own error workflow: a failed scheduled run posts one line to the room. Credentials are created by n8n/scripts/hermes-digests-setup.sh.
